headline: Nigeria Opens Bid Portal for 40 Oil and Gas Blocks on Nov 20
summary: Nigeria's oil regulator announced that its licensing bid portal for 40 oil and gas blocks will officially open on Friday, November 20.
why: Licensing rounds dictate future upstream investment, exploration activity, and production capacity for petroleum-dependent economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: New oil and gas block allocations affect long-term upstream energy production and investment inflows.
